name: Xeuledoc
description: Reads the public metadata of link-shared Google Drive documents — owner name, email and account id, last modifier, timestamps and sharing role — and writes it into the graph. Desktop only. A port of xeuledoc by Malfrats Industries (github.com/Malfrats/xeuledoc), licensed GPL-3.0.

plugins.name: Xeuledoc
plugins.description: Reads the public metadata of a link-shared Google Docs/Drive file — owner name, email and account id, last modifier, creation and modification times, and the link-sharing role — and writes it into the graph. Desktop only. Uses the Drive web client's own public endpoint, which Google may change or restrict without notice. A port of xeuledoc by Malfrats Industries (github.com/Malfrats/xeuledoc), licensed GPL-3.0.

url.title: Document URL or ID
url.description: Optional. A Google Docs/Drive link or file id. Separate several with newlines or commas. Used in addition to any selected URL nodes.

create_person.title: Also create a Person node for the owner
create_person.description: Off by default: Person nodes de-duplicate on full name, so two unrelated owners sharing a display name would merge into one person appearing to own both documents.

web_probe.purpose: Query Google's Drive metadata endpoint (clients6.google.com) anonymously for each document id. The request must carry no cookies and no Origin header — a browser fetch cannot satisfy that, which is why this plugin is desktop-only.
